25 Continuous water waves are diffracted through a gap in a barrier in a ripple tank.
Which change will cause the diffraction of the waves to increase?
A
increasing the frequency of the waves
B
increasing the width of the gap
C
reducing the wavelength of the waves
D
reducing the width of the gap

hints: Notice the two variables in the ripple tank question: the water wavelength set by the vibrator and the width of the gap in the barrier.
Recall that strong diffraction needs the gap width $w$ to be comparable to the wavelength $\lambda$, so spreading increases when $\lambda/w$ increases.
Test each change for its effect on $\lambda/w$: increasing frequency shortens $\lambda$, while narrowing the gap reduces $w$ - decide which makes the ratio larger.
walkthrough: Identify the effect: diffraction is the spreading of the water waves into the shadow region after passing through the gap.
State the governing rule: maximum spreading occurs when the gap width $w$ is similar in size to the wavelength $\lambda$, in other words when $\lambda/w$ is large.
Link frequency to wavelength: for water waves of speed $v$, $v = f\lambda$, so at constant $v$ increasing $f$ decreases $\lambda$ and reducing $f$ increases $\lambda$.
Compare the changes: increasing $w$ or decreasing $\lambda$ makes $\lambda/w$ smaller and reduces spreading, while decreasing $w$ or increasing $\lambda$ makes $\lambda/w$ larger.
Reducing the width of the gap directly increases $\lambda/w$ and gives more circular spreading. This is option D.

A.explanation: Increasing frequency decreases wavelength because $\lambda = v/f$, so the wavelength becomes smaller compared with the gap and spreading decreases.

B.explanation: A wider gap makes the gap width much larger than the wavelength, so the waves continue straight with little spreading.

C.explanation: A smaller wavelength makes the ratio $\lambda/w$ smaller, so the waves diffract less through the same gap.

D.explanation: A narrower gap makes the gap width comparable to the wavelength, so the ratio $\lambda/w$ increases and the waves spread more strongly.
